entries.title: Underwater engineers 120327-A-PF724-002.jpg
entries.description: On board LCU-2018, Five Forks, an Army Reserve Landing Craft, Utility, crewed by soldiers from Detachment 1, 481st Transportation Company. Spc. Max Janusz of Slotts City, Mont., a second class diver with the 569th Engineer Detachment, waits to have his equipment inspected before diving into rough seas of the Persian Gulf during a training exercise, March 27, 2012.
entries.creator: Sgt. Christopher Bigelow

entries.title: Army engineers build troop morale in Kandahar City 110514-A-DE255-003.jpg
entries.description: Capt. Dwayne Gist, commander, Headquarters and Headquarters Company, 4th Brigade Support Battalion, 1BCT, 4th Infantry Division, gives a congratulatory handshake to Sgt. Robby Lill, project non-commissioned officer in charge, assigned to 322nd Engineering Company, 368th Engineering Battalion, currently attached to 1BCT, 4th Infantry Division, during a ceremony May 14, to present certificates of achievement to the soldiers of the 322nd Engineer Company, 368th Engineer Battalion, for their hard work in completing construction on a Morale, Welfare and Recreation pavilion on Forward Operating Base Walton. Fifteen to 20 soldiers from the 322nd Engineer Company worked around the clock for nearly a week and a half to complete construction on the pavilion. Unit: 1st Brigade Combat Team, 4th Infantry Division Public Affairs
entries.creator: Sgt. Breanne Pye

entries.title: Missouri National Guard 1438th Engineer Company 121106-F-RN544-514.jpg
entries.description: U.S. Missouri National Guard, 1438th Engineer Company, 1st Platoon Bridge Company, builds a ferry to transport assets, Jefferson City, Mo., Nov. 6, 2012. The ferry is able to carry vehicles, supplies, and soldiers across large bodies of water. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Justyn M. Freeman/Released)
entries.creator: Airman 1st Class Justyn Freeman
